channel.title: Project Planar Player's Guide
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Project Planar Player's Guide

item.title: 457 It That Is
item.description: 457 · It That Is It That Is holds the present, a busy city full of people going about their business.

item.title: 458 It That Will Be
item.description: 458 · It That Will Be It That Will Be holds the future, an endless field under a sky full of stars, with trees at the edge that nobody has ever walked to.

item.title: 456 It That Was
item.description: 456 · It That Was It That Was holds the past, a wide lake ringed on every side by waterfalls that nobody has reached, however long they row.

item.title: 245 Walking in Temporalis
item.description: 245 · Walking in Temporalis Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here another way, tell me. Temporalis is three places.

item.title: 244 Tied On in Ventis
item.description: 244 · Tied On in Ventis Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here another way, tell me. Ventis is mostly open sky.

item.title: 449 Zaros
item.description: 449 · Zaros Zaros was the dragon lord of Air until the ascendant god Afthor killed him, drank his blood and took the realm, fifty years ago.

item.title: 460 The Wind Gods
item.description: 460 · The Wind Gods Four of them, one for each quarter of Ventis.

item.title: 461 Boreas
item.description: 461 · Boreas Boreas is the north wind.

item.title: 462 Eurus
item.description: 462 · Eurus Eurus is the east wind, warm and bright, and the only one of the four who keeps a form that is pleasant to be near. He likes mortals.

item.title: 463 Notus
item.description: 463 · Notus Notus is the south wind.
